text_block_list.text:
I fell behind this time.
However, I won't make the same mistake twice.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"How we could have won today's race." 
Let's compile our opinions on that.
choice_data_list: Next time, we will definitely win!

text_block_list.text: You're stating the obvious, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...The strong have no time to look down in despair.
My eyes are set on the future me, who will surpass the present.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry about things like 'just finishing a race.'
Now, go prepare for your training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very well. Today's result is an opportunity for both of us to refocus our minds—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: For the next race, our goal will be an overwhelming victory.
